An '''''Imperial Recruitment Poster''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was a [[Propaganda/Legends|recruitment]] poster requesting youths to join the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], with a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] at the front and [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Writing/Legends|writing]]. It was often sold during [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, although they sometimes ended up vandalized by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers. Those featured a red "X" over the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Writing/Legends|writing]] and the [[Alliance Starbird|Rebel Starbird]] spray-painted over the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper's helmet]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Recruitment Poster was sold during Empire Day festivities for 20x Empire Day tokens prior to Star Wars Galaxies closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
